requirements.title: Submit a credit application
requirements.story: As an applicant I want to submit a loan application so that I get an immediate decision.
acceptance: POST /api/applications returns 201 Created with a Location header
The response carries a CL- reference number and the engine's decision
The response matches the published ApplicationResponse contract

requirements.title: Explainable decisions
requirements.story: As an applicant or auditor I want every refer or decline to state why.
acceptance: Every REFERRED/DECLINED decision lists at least one reason code
An APPROVED decision lists no reason codes
Reason codes come with a human-readable description

requirements.title: Credit score bands
acceptance: Score below 600 declines with CS01
Score 600-659 refers with CS02
Score 660 and above passes

requirements.title: Debt-to-income including the new payment
acceptance: DTI = (existing debt + new payment) / monthly income
DTI above 50% declines with DTI1
DTI above 40% up to 50% refers with DTI2
DTI of exactly 40% passes

requirements.title: Loan-to-income
acceptance: Requested amount above annual income declines with LTI1
Above 50% of income refers with LTI2
Exactly 50% passes

requirements.title: Employment verification
acceptance: Unemployed declines with EMP1
Self-employed and student income refers with EMP2
Full-time, part-time and retired pass

requirements.title: Minimum income
acceptance: Annual income below $20,000 declines with INC1
Exactly $20,000 passes

requirements.title: Worst outcome wins, all reasons reported
acceptance: Any decline reason means DECLINED
Otherwise any refer reason means REFERRED
All failing rules are reported, decline reasons listed first

requirements.title: Risk-based pricing and payment math
acceptance: APR follows the credit-score band and product adjustment
Monthly payment is the amortized payment rounded to the cent
Risk score is 0-100

requirements.title: What-if preview
requirements.story: As an applicant I want to see a live decision while I type, without anything being saved.
acceptance: POST /api/decisions/preview returns a decision
Preview never creates an application
Preview and submit give the same decision for the same profile
The UI preview updates as the form changes

requirements.title: Underwriter review
requirements.story: As an underwriter I want to approve or decline referred applications with a note.
acceptance: Only REFERRED applications can be reviewed (409 Conflict otherwise)
Underwriter name and note are mandatory
Approving sets the approved amount; declining clears it

requirements.title: Audit trail
acceptance: Every application has an AUTO_DECISION audit entry
A manual review appends a MANUAL_REVIEW entry with from/to status, actor and note
Entries carry the rules version

requirements.title: Server-side validation
acceptance: Invalid input returns 400 with an RFC 9457 problem body
Field errors name each invalid field
Unknown ids return 404

requirements.title: Paged, filtered application list
acceptance: Newest first
Filter by status
Page size capped at 100

requirements.title: Portfolio dashboard
acceptance: GET /api/stats counts by status
Counts reconcile with the list endpoint
The dashboard shows the tiles and the table

requirements.title: Security
acceptance: OWASP secure headers on every API response
No stack traces or exception names leak to clients
Email masked in responses
Correlation ids are validated (no log injection)
CORS only allows the known front-end origin
SQL-injection style input is stored as plain data

requirements.title: Performance
acceptance: Preview p95 under 300 ms with 20 concurrent users
Submit p95 under 500 ms
0% errors during the load test

requirements.title: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
acceptance: No serious or critical axe-core violations on any screen
Form fields have accessible labels
Pages are keyboard operable

requirements.title: Resilience of the UI
acceptance: When the API is down the UI says so instead of hanging
A 500 shows a safe message with the support reference
Server-side field errors are shown next to the field
Slow responses show a loading state

requirements.title: Operational readiness
acceptance: /actuator/health reports UP
Decision metrics are exposed in Prometheus format
Every response returns an X-Correlation-Id
